patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right in front of a thing tells you which thing is meant, like 'that...' in English. おぼえているわざ = 'moves that it knows'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state that is still going on. おぼえる is 'to learn', so おぼえている = 'has learned and still knows'.
